hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

claims.text: The resort sits amid 600 acres of oak-covered hills in the Texas Hill Country near San Antonio.

findings.quote: nestled amid 600 acres of oak-covered hills near downtown San Antonio, Texas Hill Country

claims.text: Resort guests have exclusive access to the River Bluff Water Experience, a nine-acre water park with water slides.

findings.quote: Resort guests have exclusive access to the River Bluff Water Experience at our hotel in North San Antonio, with a nine-acre water park and water slides.

claims.text: The water park includes an activity pool, waterfalls, a 1,100-foot lazy river and a 650-foot action river ride.

findings.quote: Endless adventure is found across an expansive activity pool, free-flowing waterfalls, a 1,100-foot lazy river and a 650-foot action river ride.

claims.text: The water park has a Sand Beach Pool where guests can build sandcastles.

findings.quote: building sandcastles at the Sand Beach Pool, the nine-acre water park

claims.text: TPC San Antonio has two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by Pete Dye and Greg Norman.

findings.quote: TPC San Antonio opened in January 2010 with two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by two of golf’s most innovative architects: Pete Dye and Greg Norman.

claims.text: Lantana Spa offers massage, beauty and wellness therapies inspired by the traditions of Latin American Curanderos.

findings.quote: Discover a full menu of massage, beauty, and wellness therapies embracing the spirit and traditions of Latin American Curanderos.

claims.text: Lantana Spa has a private, lagoon-like pool, a spa cafe and a spa boutique.

findings.quote: guests can enjoy the peaceful serenity of the private, lagoon-like pool, healthy refreshments at our spa café and then shop at our spa boutique.

claims.text: Select rooms have private Juliet or walkout balconies with views of the rolling hills.

findings.quote: Select spaces offer private Juliet or walkout balconies with sweeping views of the rolling hills outside San Antonio.

claims.text: The Golf View Suites have oversized balconies overlooking the TPC San Antonio golf courses.

findings.quote: Our 9 Golf View Suites offer 1,200 square feet of luxurious resort living with oversized balconies overlooking the TPC San Antonio golf courses.

claims.text: 18 Oaks is the resort's signature steakhouse, rooted in the flavors of Texas.

findings.quote: 18 Oaks, our hotel's signature steakhouse restaurant in North San Antonio, is steeped in the authentic flavors of Texas.

claims.text: A self-guided art tour highlights artists of Texas and the wider United States.

findings.quote: this self-guided tour highlights incredible artists of Texas and the wider United States

claims.text: Natural Bridge Caverns, Six Flags Fiesta Texas and Texas wine country are within an hour's drive.

findings.quote: Natural Bridge Caverns, Six Flags Fiesta Texas, and the Lone Star State’s wine country are all within an hour drive.

claims.text: The Oaks course has hosted the PGA Tour's Valero Texas Open since 2010.

findings.quote: The Oaks course serving as the host of the PGA Tour’s Valero Texas Open since 2010

claims.text: Lantana Spa guests receive a red ribbon on arrival as part of the Seven Knots Ritual to release worries and stress.

findings.quote: Upon arrival, Lantana Spa guests are given a piece of red ribbon. Part of the Seven Knots Ritual to release worries and stress

claims.text: The water park has an infinity pool for adults overlooking the Texas Hill Country.

findings.quote: relax in the adults-only infinity pool overlooking the Texas Hill Country

claims.text: The Grand River Suites incorporate the style of the San Antonio haciendas that grew into Texas ranches.

findings.quote: Named after the Grand Rivers of Texas, our five Grand River Suites offer details reflective of the expansive Texas Hill Country
The style of the San Antonio haciendas that later grew into the legendary Texas ranches has been incorporated into these expansive suites

claims.text: Each Grand River Suite has a fireplace, a library and a dining room that seats up to 8.

findings.quote: a dining room that seats up to 8, multiple 65” LCD HDTVs, a fireplace, a library, and a powder room
Each of our Grand River suites features a magnificent entry hall

claims.text: The resort is 14 miles northeast of San Antonio International Airport.

findings.quote: How far is the resort from San Antonio International Airport (SAT)?
The resort is 14 miles NE of the airport
